title: Unsanctioned Magic
description: Reports have reached the Arcane Circle of a rogue mage practicing forbidden magic near Millbrook. The guild cannot tolerate unsanctioned practitioners, especially those dabbling in dangerous arts. Track down this rogue mage and bring them to justice - or help them see the error of their ways.

settle_the_rogue.description: Settle the rogue mage, however you like

objectives.description: Question townspeople about the rogue mage
objectives.notes: Innkeeper has seen strange lights in the woods

objectives.description: Locate the rogue mage's hideout in the forest
Persuade the rogue mage to give up the forbidden arts
objectives.notes: QuestInteractable rogue_mage_parley at the forest camp rolls this DC itself

objectives.description: Report the outcome to Archmage Elara

notes: Second Apprentice quest. Moral choice: kill or persuade. Different flags based on player choice. Rewards ice spell. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
